_manifestNotes.runtime: RPG Maker MV HTML5 via WebView2 or complete RPG Maker MV Windows deployment via Game.exe
_manifestNotes.gamePackageFormat: Per-game packageFormat: mv-html5-www (ZIP containing www/) or mv-windows-deployment (complete Windows deployment with Game.exe and either package.nw or a valid root package.json whose main points to an existing entry file, normally www/index.html).
_manifestNotes.wwwReplacementRule: For mv-html5-www, the downloaded www folder replaces the existing installed www folder. For mv-windows-deployment, the complete deployment folder replaces the managed game install contents after backup.
howToAddNewGame: Copy the _gameTemplate object and paste it into the games array.
Change id to a unique value, then set name, latestVersion, and channel.
Set runtimeType to mvhtml5 or mv-exe and packageFormat to mv-html5-www or mv-windows-deployment.
Configure downloadUrl, downloadUrls, repairUrl, fileName, sizeBytes, and SHA-256 values.
For mv-html5-www, set executableName to index.html and include www/index.html in files.

For mv-windows-deployment, set executableName to Game.exe and include the complete exported Windows deployment. Include package.nw or a valid root package.json whose main entry resolves to an existing file (standard MV: www/index.html), plus the full www game folder and NW.js runtime files.
ZIPs may contain one enclosing game folder; TSBCPlay locates the executable and validates the deployment root.
Add files verification entries relative to the deployment root for Windows packages or install root for HTML5 packages.
